date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
title: Deichmann says hackers accessed customer data in its online shop; Snipes also affected
summary: Unknown hackers accessed customer data in Deichmann's online shop, per Der Spiegel (via UA.NEWS) and dpa. Deichmann says names, addresses, invoices, email addresses and phone numbers may be affected, but not passwords, login details or payment data. It says it blocked the access, closed the vulnerability, filed a criminal complaint and has no indications of misuse. APA says customers in Austria were also informed, and dpa says subsidiary Snipes is also affected.
plain: Deichmann says hackers accessed some customer data in its online shop. It says names, contact details and invoices may be affected, but not passwords or payment data.
exec: Deichmann reports unauthorised access to customer data in its online shop; it says the access was blocked and it has no indications of misuse.
action: As Deichmann advises, be alert to phishing; the company says it never asks for passwords or payment data by email, phone or SMS.

validation.note: UA.NEWS (relaying Der Spiegel) and Marktspiegel/vol.at (dpa, APA) each state Deichmann's statement; Deichmann's own notice was not read.

review.note: attribution: Austria is from APA (vol.at), Snipes from dpa; summary said dpa for both
